sections.heading: How We Chose the Best Cordless Handheld Vacuums
paragraphs: The supplied Amazon search results were used for product discovery, ASINs, product images, listing titles, price snapshots, ratings, review counts, and sponsored status. Priority was given to models with established manufacturer documentation and independent test evidence.

Advertised suction numbers such as Pa, watts, voltage, or “high power” are not directly comparable across every vacuum design. Real-world pickup depends heavily on nozzle geometry, airflow, brush agitation, and sealing.
